definitions.explanation: a cutting technique where a round vegetable is first cut in half lengthwise, then sliced crosswise to create half-moon shaped pieces

examples.japanese: ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{半月切|はんげつぎ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Cut the daikon into half-moon slices.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人参|にんじん}→人参：05185_ninjin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{半月切|はんげつぎ}りにして⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I cut the carrot into half-moons and added them to the simmered dish.

examples.japanese: {半月切|はんげつぎ}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{厚|あつ}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揃|そろ}える→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{均等|きんとう}→均等：19459_kintou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧。
examples.english: If you make the half-moon slices uniform in thickness, they will cook evenly.

notes:
{半月切|はんげつぎ}り is named for its ⟦{半月|はんげつ}→半月：08507_hangetsu⟧ (half-moon) shape. Cut a round vegetable in half lengthwise, then slice crosswise into semicircles.

COMMON VEGETABLES:
Used for round vegetables like ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧ (daikon), ⟦{人参|にんじん}→人参：05185_ninjin⟧ (carrot), {茄子|なす} (eggplant), and ⟦{胡瓜|きゅうり}→胡瓜：05195_kyuuri⟧ (cucumber).

TIPS:
Keep the {厚|あつ}さ (thickness) uniform so pieces cook evenly. For thinner vegetables, ⟦{輪切|わぎ}り→輪切り：07474_wagiri⟧ (full rounds) may be more appropriate.

RELATED CUTTING TECHNIQUES:
- ⟦{輪切|わぎ}り→輪切り：07474_wagiri⟧: full round slices
- ⟦いちょう{切|ぎ}り→いちょう切り：08092_ichougiri⟧: quarter rounds (ginkgo-leaf shaped)
- ⟦{斜|なな}め{切|ぎ}り→斜め切り：08090_nanamegiri⟧: diagonal cut
- ⟦{千切|せんぎ}り→千切り：07473_sengiri⟧: julienne, fine strips
